summary: All 6 phases complete. Verified at every layer with real headless-nvim tests: scratch unit tests (Phases 2-4) and a full scratch integration test against the real manager.load/unload/reload functions (Phase 5) prove zero data loss and zero flattening for symlink deploy mode, with discriminating power proven against the actual pre-fix code. Restored the two previously-flattened symlinks after content verification and recorded the ownership rule in a new context document (Phase 6). No loader operation was ever run against the real .claude/ tree.
